headlines.title: Jim Cramer says investors aren't ditching tech — they just want cheaper stocks
headlines.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said investors aren’t abandoning AI or technology stocks — they’re rotating out of high-multiple names and into cheaper stocks.

headlines.title: The Builders Stage brings practical strategies for scaling startups to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
headlines.summary: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt, bringing together founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations on what it takes to build and scale.

headlines.title: How Equinix has found a niche in the multitrillion-dollar AI data center boom
headlines.summary: Nvidia announced a new data center deal with Equinix and Together AI on Wednesday to help enterprise customers with open-model inference.

headlines.title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
headlines.summary: The acquisition also leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.

headlines.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
headlines.summary: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time, providing more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.

headlines.title: Broadcom’s stock falls despite upbeat earnings, extending a frustrating stretch for investors
headlines.summary: Broadcom topped expectations with its latest quarterly financial results, but that wasn’t enough to send its stock higher.

headlines.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Real World AI Stage features Nvidia, robots, and extinct animals
headlines.summary: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

headlines.title: Broadcom delivers strong earnings view as CEO touts growth with AI labs
headlines.summary: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.

headlines.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
headlines.summary: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

headlines.title: We’re in our 60s. We earn $345,000 and have $1 million in 403(b)s. Is it too late for Roth conversions?
headlines.summary: “Roth assets would provide our children with tax-free distributions.”

headlines.title: Google spared from ad-business breakup, but judge orders changes to how it operates
headlines.summary: Google has dodged an effort to break up its ad business, but a judge said Wednesday that the company will need to adjust its business to benefit competitors.

headlines.title: Nvidia’s stock is climbing as investors get more confidence in an expanding base of AI customers
headlines.summary: Dell’s earnings showed that demand for AI hardware extends beyond major cloud providers.
